phases.blurb: Play the story in order, Chapters 1 to 5. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (it is the one thing you can miss) and the time-sensitive race against Yago in Chapter 3.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Play the story

phases.blurb: Stranger strands and side-character finales. The eight stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks, the five side-character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), Bret's hunting and Cal's fishing. Side finales stay open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
phases.title: Phase 2 — Side content

phases.blurb: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles, areas and garages. Do these while exploring: WAiNK tagging pairs with exploring all 52 areas, and scanning vehicles pairs with driving everywhere anyway.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Collectibles and exploration

phases.blurb: Shooting range golds, drone races, stunts, races, challenges, arcade games and the rest of the open-world activities. Most of these are pure practice: learn the pattern, then go for the win.
phases.title: Phase 4 — Activities and skill

phases.blurb: Jewelry stores, bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations and the money trophies. The tools arrive through story and optional missions in Chapters 3 and 4, so this phase opens up in the middle of the game. Bring your partner: several of these need two people.
phases.title: Phase 5 — Robberies and money

phases.blurb: The last stretch: the 100% completion checklist (35 tasks, under Progress, then Stats, after the story) and the slow counters that fill up as you play, then the platinum pops on its own.
phases.title: Phase 6 — Cleanup and the platinum
